en: A black-and-white image showing a footbridge over a small stream, with several people (men, women, and children) standing on or around the bridge. The people are dressed in late 19th or early 20th-century European clothing, with women in long dresses and hats. In the distance, there are industrial buildings with smokestacks and two large church spires rising above the trees and rooftops, suggesting a European cityscape.
